out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Separation of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials (chemical sanitizer spray bottle) are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food on front prep counter.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items by separating the poisonous and toxic materials by spacing or partitioning. CDI: CFM relocated the chemical spray bottle to shelf in back kitchen area away from food, single-service items, and kitchen equipment/ utensils.

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Observed chemical spray bottle (sanitizer) is not properly labeled with a common name on front prep counter.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. CDI: CFM placed common name of chemical spray bottle (sanitizer).

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed unapproved backflow prevention device (‘Y” splitter) on the water supply system.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. CDI: CFM stated that plumber built in over pressure system within the mop sink faucet and replaced the entire valve system. CFM stated they only use one attached hose at a time (turn water knob off). EHS will discuss further with health department management for follow up.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. CDI: EHS provided CFM copy of written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Dead or Trapped Pest Removed
violations.observation: Observed excessive dead flies covering two sticky fly traps in the corner of the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Remove dead rodents, birds, and insects from the premises to ensure that the establishment is clean and sanitary and to prevent carcasses from attracting other pests. EHS instructed CFM to remove traps ASAP.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed two hoses attached to unapproved backflow prevention device (“U” shaped) on the mop sink in kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. CDI: CFM removed unapproved backflow prevention device on mop sink and will not attach both hoses to mop sink until they obtained an approved backflow prevention device.

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: Interior surfaces of the GALAXY upright refrigerator was observed to be soiled and in need of cleaning. Debris accumulation was noted on the interior base of this refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. Maintain the surfaces of the interior of refrigerators in clean condition at all times to prevent food contamination. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. Three unmarked spray bottles containing cleaning chemicals, were not labeled.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. The three bottles were labeled properly, identifying contents, during the inspection.
